question: What division of eight groups of eight is sought to be fully known?
premises: A division into eight groups of eight is named
Full knowledge of this division is desired
The desire is expressed as endless or complete
inference: The speaker seeks to fully know the division of the eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: I wish to fully know the division of the eight groups of eight in its entirety.
